name: LMU physics exterior courtyard
references: sources.json: BVV LoD2 courtyard outline, DGM1 terrain and DOP20 imagery
vegetation-sources.json: pinned BVV DOM20 canopy heights and Poly Haven CC0 leaf/bark atlases
qualification: Open-air courtyard only. The LoD2 interior ground-ring defines its boundary; DGM1 supplies terrain and DOP20 supplies broad colour. Tree candidates and crown extents come from DOP20/DOM20 outside surveyed buildings. Trunk locations, branches, species appearance and leaf arrangement are estimates. No building interiors, invented furniture or reference-photo textures. Native visual and collision review remains required.
